en-US.description:
Keep your Koenekt management tools in one place.

Sign in to your workspace to manage staff, add new starters, update employee details, mark leavers and run attendance reports. Use the tools enabled for your account, including live attendance, clock management and payroll.

Koenekt management accounts can also manage customers and licences and control Reporter updates across enrolled PCs.
